sources.title: 薇薇安娜
sources.paraphrase: The ordinary not-yet-charged cast spends the minimum amount. Once charged mode has been acquired, it persists until the next Skill end even if current SP later decreases; current SP alone cannot reconstruct that history.
sources.nativeBoundary: Fresh components and the mode template independently show a threshold checker, unmanaged mode Buff, skill-start SP clear and skill-end mode removal. This batch does not replay the whole cast.

sources.title: 流明
sources.paraphrase: Lumen S2 has a charged enhancement and consumes the current stored SP. The fresh bound judge template samples enhancement eligibility and explicitly clears SP.
sources.nativeBoundary: The exact call ordering for every Skill Behaviour and generic base-cost payment is not newly expanded here.
